en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4312 - Abdullah ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said that
Abu Abdillah (as) said: "There is no valid oath taken in anger, nor in severing ties of kinship, nor under coercion, nor under compulsion."
I asked: "May Allah (swt) keep you well, what is the difference between coercion and compulsion?"
Imam (as) replied: "Compulsion is from a ruler, while coercion can come from a wife, a father, or a mother, and such an oath is of no consequence."
